stages:
- stage: __default
  jobs:
  - job: hobo_ci
    pool:
      name: hobo-local
    steps:
    - task: Bash@3
      displayName: Run HoBo CI checks
      inputs:
        targetType: inline
        script: node packages/ci-ado/dist/cli.js run packages/ci-ado/examples/ci.json . --expected-plan 2445bc2eab4dc39db60e672575c4f387817eed692572b3dc5afa3e8b466b0648 --artifacts "$HOBO_CI_ARTIFACT_DIRECTORY"
    - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
      displayName: Publish verified execution bundle
  - job: hobo_ci_verify_artifacts
    pool:
      name: hobo-local
    steps:
    - task: DownloadPipelineArtifact@2
      displayName: Download execution bundle
    - task: Bash@3
      displayName: Verify downloaded artifact hashes
      inputs:
        targetType: inline
        script: node packages/ci-ado/dist/cli.js verify "$HOBO_CI_DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY" --config packages/ci-ado/examples/ci.json --expected-plan 2445bc2eab4dc39db60e672575c4f387817eed692572b3dc5afa3e8b466b0648 --expected-bundle "$HOBO_CI_EXPECTED_BUNDLE_DIGEST"
